facts.fact: The BCRG's Comite des agrements issued Decision D/2015/003/CAM of 31 March 2015 on e-money issuance and e-money establishments (EME), binding from its date of signature and published in the Journal Officiel, as reproduced in the BCRG's December 2017 compendium of banking texts.
facts.system: Decision D/2015/003/CAM on e-money and e-money establishments

facts.fact: Decision D/2015/003/CAM requires e-money establishments, which it places in the category of financial establishments (not banks) and constitutes as Guinean limited companies, to obtain a licence from the BCRG's Comite des agrements, with a decision due within 90 days of a complete file.
facts.system: Decision D/2015/003/CAM on e-money and e-money establishments

facts.fact: Decision D/2015/008/CAM of 3 June 2015 sets the minimum share capital of e-money establishments in Guinea at GNF 2 billion, to be held in Guinean francs and employed in Guinea.
facts.system: Decision D/2015/008/CAM on minimum capital of e-money establishments

facts.fact: Article 5 of banking law L/2013/060/CNT, promulgated by decree on 28 November 2013, allows service providers other than credit institutions to be authorised, in a limited way, to provide and manage means of payment under rules set by a Comite des agrements decision.

note: Art. 52 of the 2015 e-money decision requires an EME's technology to have an interoperability function with other systems; it names no switch and sets no connection deadline, so no connect fact is recorded.
